title: Comfy chair
text: Comfy chair. A bit pricy but I really needed this chair. I love everything about this chair except that you can’t lift the foot rest without the back going down too.  It's like a magic chair that puts you to sleep, love it!!!!

product_metadata.title: CANMOV Power Lift Recliner Chair for Elderly Heavy Duty and Safety Motion Reclining Mechanism-Anti Skid Fabric Sofa Living Room Chair with USB Port, 2 Cup Holders, Washable Covers, Camel
features: Power Lift Recliner Chair: Crafted with smooth transitioning reclining and lifting features. Our power lift chair reclines up to 160 degrees, smoothly adjust to lift or reclining position you prefer by pressing two buttons on the armrest, which is easy to operate for people of all ages. Suitable for living room, bedroom, home theater or even your office.

USB Charging Ports & Cup Holders: With the help of the USB ports, keep your must-have devices fully charged and close to you. Meanwhile, This recliner features 2 silver cup holders on both sides, which brings you unexpected home theatering experience. (Notes: The USB Ports ONLY for low-power devices, such as iPhone, iPad.)

Detachable Sofa Cover: 4 removable and washable covers for easily washing and drying cover the top, two armrests and the seat. The side pocket is convenient for you to store some small items, like books. Our lift recliners are made of high-quality short plush which is soft and fluffy, wear resistance.

Easy Assembly & Easy Using: Less 10 mins installation, all functions used by only two buttons on the armrest. Overall size: 36"W x 37"D x 41"H, Seat Height – 20.4", Seat Dimensions - 22"W x 21.6"D, its max weight capacity is about 300lbs. Kindly please confirm the size before buying. Tips: The lift chair comes with 2 boxes and we ship them on the same day but the carrier may deliver them to your door on different days.

Buy With Confidence: We are confident that you’ll be absolutely flabbergasted by the unique quality, durability, functionality and design of our power lift chair. CANMOV provide free exchange for installation problems, damaged and missing parts with 1-year warranty guarantee, feel free to contact us for any purchase.
